note: Two findings of Qodo on pull request 44 of bettersandeep/lekha, cut from the full record in day08/qodo-record-pr44.json. Nothing in them was edited.

findings.title: Local review adds an extra fix round
findings.description: `LOCAL_FIX_ATTEMPTS = 1` gives the local Qodo review its own agent round, and `local_attempts` is checked separately from `attempts` in `Run.work`. The pull request review can still spend its 2 rounds, so one run can start the agent 3 times for review findings, which the checklist forbids for blocking review findings. A local threshold finding that comes back after the local round is also committed rather than sent to the shared budget.

findings.title: Local review can drive two fix rounds
findings.description: The local-review branch in `Run.work` takes its fix round from the same `attempts` counter as the failed-check and pull-request-review rounds, which starts at `FIX_ATTEMPTS = 2`. Each blocking local review does `attempts -= 1` and then `continue`, so two consecutive local reviews with findings can each start the agent, and only the local review spends the budget. The test `test_an_open_local_finding_after_the_rounds_needs_a_human_with_no_commit` confirms this: three agent starts, two of them driven by local findings. The PR description and the ticket-derived rule allow one local fix round per run, separate from the two pull-request rounds, so the code allows more review-driven fix rounds than the limit.
